```python
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path
import re, datetime, os

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/51958/1_51958_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/51958_0_f2ab6c99/1_51958_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"] if "Sheet1" in wb.sheetnames else wb.active

raw = ws["A2"].value
if raw is None:
    result = None
else:
    s = str(raw)
    # Parse strings like "9th Aug 10:08" (also accepts 1st/2nd/3rd/11th etc.).
    m = re.search(r"(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)?\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})", s)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f"Cannot parse date/time from A2: {raw!r}")
    day = int(m.group(1))
    mon_text = m.group(2)[:3].title()
    month = datetime.datetime.strptime(mon_text, "%b").month
    hour = int(m.group(3))
    minute = int(m.group(4))
    # The requested standardized example uses year 2021 ("yy" = 21).
    result = datetime.datetime(2021, month, day, hour, minute)

ws["B2"].value = result
ws["B2"].number_format = "dd/mm/yy hh:mm"

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification
wb2 = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)
cell = wb2["Sheet1" if "Sheet1" in wb2.sheetnames else wb2.sheetnames[0]]["B2"]
print(cell.value, type(cell.value), cell.number_format)
```
